en: A sepia-toned street view showing a broad, straight avenue lined with multi‑story historic buildings. Tram tracks run along the center of the street, with overhead wires visible. On the right are ornate facades with tall windows and shop awnings; on the left are older, simpler houses and a larger corner building. A few pedestrians and small carts appear in the distance. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Graz. Leonhardstrasse".
